en:
Kaede, would you like to have some tea
and chat for a bit?

<CLT=cltMIND>"Kaede, would you like to have
some tea and chat for a bit?"

<CLT=cltMIND>And here I am, sitting across from Rantaro,
drinking tea with him. I wonder...
Hey, are you hitting on me?
Ha, no, I'm not trying to hit on you.

I guess people assume I'm a sleazy guy
because of the way I look, but I'm not.

Besides, "would you like to have some tea?"
What kinda old-school pickup line is that?

Hm... But maybe it's so old-school that it's
looped around and become cool again.
Haha, yeah, maybe.

Although, it is true that I wanted
to spend some time with you.

I'm surrounded by strong personalities... I like
them, but it's a tad overwhelming at times.

Yeah, a lot of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> students here
are pretty unique.
Oh, but I think Shuichi is pretty normal.

Now that's true, but he's a detective.
Could be hiding his real personality, y'know?

But he's reliable in tough situations.
That's not so bad, is it?

True, but the sort of situation where you
might need a reliable detective would be...
Would be...?
Nah, it's nothing.
Miu
Kiyo
Keebo
Are you unsure of something?

By the way, who's the most...unique person
here, in your eyes?
Um...Miu.

Yeah, Miu's talent is...beyond understanding
for ordinary people like us.

But I understand her thought process.
She likes to be the one on top.
On top...?
Haha, sorry, I was trying to make a joke...
Hmmm...Kiyo.
Oh yeah, talk about first impressions...

But you know, he isn't so hard to
understand if you talk to him a little.

He's always calm, and he seems pretty sharp.
I think he could end up being pretty reliable.
Keebo...

Being a robot is interesting enough that his
personality barely matters.
But you know, I think Keebo is on our side...
What do you mean, on our side?

Have you ever heard of the Three Laws
of Robotics?

The long and short of it is...
robots can't harm people.

If Keebo's creator was a good scientist, he
would have programmed that into Keebo's AI.

We're all human, so we can assume that he's
on our side.
...Of course, I'm just guessing.
You seem pretty composed, Rantaro...
Where did that come from?

From how you observe everyone and make
rational judgments about their personalities.
You think so?

<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah...how do I put this? It's like he's
already used to this kind of situation...

<CLT=cltMIND>But that's a weird way to put it... There's no
way he could be used to any of this.

Well, I guess I feel more relaxed around you.
I almost feel...normal.

Oh, but don't misunderstand!
I mean normal in a good way.
Hahaha, okay, I get it.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Rantaro's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.
<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time drinking tea with Rantaro...
